title: I_need_my_meds is taking over the music scene by storm with his recent track “Demons”
htmlContent:
Daniel Hatfield, popularly known as I_need_my_meds, is a talented singer and songwriter who has raised bars to get to where he is today. Being a Bipolar disorder diagnosed patient, my talent has been unstoppable in reaching new heights. He again displays his talent in releasing his recent track "Demons."

I_need_my_meds "Demons" is all about facing his inner demons. Having Bipolar Disorder, the artist has been taking medications his whole life and came out to express himself through his music. This incredible work of art melts you with every groove once you press the play button.
